mentions.name: Cross-platform Lightweight Spreadsheet Application
mentions.description: A cross-platform spreadsheet application that looks and works identically on Windows, macOS, and Linux, and stays lightweight while behaving the way users expect a spreadsheet to, indefinitely. It can open spreadsheets that have grown past 100MB without the long load times typical of existing tools.
mentions.problem: Existing spreadsheet/web apps frustrate users with blocked basic interactions (e.g., Google Docs/Drive preventing right-click copy) and spreadsheets grown to 100MB+ take painfully long to load.
mentions.source_excerpt: finally started working on something I've been wanted to do for a long-time, a spreadsheet application. It's cross-platform (looks and work identical across Windows, macOS and Linux), lightweight, and does what a spreadsheet application should be able to do, in the way you expect it, forever. As an extra benefit, I can finally open some spreadsheets that grown out of control (+100MB and growing) without having to go and make a cup of coffee while the spreadsheet loads.
